Dear Sirs, 
 
Sub: Presentation on Results 
 
Further to our intimation dated October 8, 2026, we wish to inform you that a presentation to 
analysts on financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended       
September 30, 2026 shall be made on October 15, 2026 at 19.15 hours IST after the Board 
meeting.  
 
Steps to join are as follows: 
 
Step 1: Click on the JioEvents link (Link), which will take you to a JioEvents Login page on 
your web browser. 
Step 2: Register for the event by filling in your details. 
Step 3: Click on Join Event on the given date and time. 
 
A transcript and video of the presentation will be posted on our website www.jfs.in and stock 
exchanges. 
 
This is for information and records. 
 
Thanking you 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Jio Financial Services Limited
